beats.note: Awashra et al., Nutrition Journal 2026, via Medical News Today (Nov 2)

beats.label: 1. Low levels
beats.text: **Low** B12 is **linked** to higher heart risk in observational studies.

beats.label: 3. Stroke
beats.text: Stroke had the **best** evidence, mostly from **B-vitamin** **combos,** not B12 alone.

beats.label: Another clue
beats.text: UC Irvine, **220,000+** U.S. adults: more B vitamins tied to **lower** stroke risk.
beats.note: Liu et al., Am J Prev Cardiol 2026 (observational)

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Diagnosed **low?** Your doctor may treat it. Otherwise B12 **isn't** a proven heart **shield.**
